# Caps the model ladder in cheap-only mode to prevent escalation to premium tiers.
# When cheap-only mode is active, returns OPENAI as the maximum allowed level.
# Otherwise, returns SONNET as the unrestricted maximum.
def max_allowed_level() -> EscalationLevel:
    return CHEAP_ONLY_MAX_LEVEL if is_cheap_only() else EscalationLevel.SONNET
